group.name: Interaction-Driven Continual Agent Improvement
group.definition: 배포된 에이전트가 장기간의 상호작용에서 얻은 궤적, 피드백, 상태를 이용해 정책·스킬·메모리·환경 구성을 갱신하는 문제를 다루며, 반복적인 실행과 평가를 개선 루프로 연결하는 기술이다. 경험을 메모리에 인코딩하고 검색·통합하거나, 실패 궤적에서 스킬과 정책을 수정하고, 필요하면 학습 환경과 피드백 조건까지 조정해 다음 실행에 반영한다. leaf_021이 주로 학생의 온폴리시 롤아웃에 토큰 수준 증류 신호를 전달하는 학습 목적과 최적화에 초점을 두는 반면, 이 그룹은 상호작용 이후 에이전트 시스템의 여러 구성요소를 지속적으로 변화시키는 더 넓은 개선 순환을 다룬다.
group.evidence_summary: 여러 구성원은 장기 상호작용에서 생성되는 궤적과 피드백을 다음 행동 개선에 연결해야 한다는 공통 문제를 다룬다. 해결 방식은 경험을 메모리에 기록·검색·통합하거나, 실패와 성공 궤적에서 스킬·문맥·정책을 갱신하고, 평가 게이트를 거쳐 개선된 구성을 다시 실행하는 순환 구조다. 일부 접근은 모델 가중치를 업데이트하고, 다른 접근은 하네스·스킬 문서·메모리처럼 모델 외부의 텍스트와 실행 구조를 최적화한다. 환경 자체를 에이전트 변화에 맞춰 재구성하는 방식도 같은 상호작용 기반 개선 순환의 확장으로 나타난다.
group.why_emerging: 정적 벤치마크와 고정된 학습 환경만으로는 도구, 사용자 요구, 작업 분포가 변하는 장기 배포 상황을 충분히 반영하기 어렵다. 동시에 긴 작업에서는 경험을 저장하고 다시 불러오며, 희소하거나 불균일한 보상에서 어떤 행동을 바꿔야 하는지 추출하는 일이 병목이 된다. 따라서 재훈련 없이 하네스와 스킬을 갱신하는 방법, 배포 중 정책을 업데이트하는 방법, 파국적 망각을 줄이는 메모리 통합 방법이 함께 요구된다. 다만 이 그룹에는 모델 학습, 외부 스킬 편집, 메모리 시스템, 환경 재구성이 함께 포함되어 있어 하나의 공통 알고리즘으로 수렴했다고 보기는 어렵다.

evaluation.scenario: 카카오뱅크 AI가 사용자의 금융 목표, 선호 수취인, 상담·이체 이력, 목표적금 납입 상황을 안전하게 장기 기억하고 다음 대화와 금융 비서 제안에 활용할 수 있다. 지속학습·메모리 통합·검증 게이트를 결합하면 사용자별 소비 가이드와 저축 코칭을 개선하면서도 오래된 정보, 충돌하는 기억, 잘못된 자기개선으로 인한 금융 오작동을 통제할 수 있다.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 AgenticOS Workshop

claims.name: Persistent Agentic Memory and State Storage
claims.evidence: Agentic AI systems increasingly persist state, plan over long horizons, coordinate multiple models and tools, and even self-evolve.

claims.name: Constrained Self-Evolving Agents
claims.evidence: How can constrained self-evolution preserve safety, reproducibility, and governance?

sources.title: Workshop on Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Agents (RL4LLM-Agents)

claims.name: Weight-Space Reinforcement Learning for LLM Agents
claims.evidence: Model-side RL updates the weights: RLHF, RLAIF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards.

claims.name: Harness-Side In-Context Reinforcement Learning
claims.evidence: Harness-side RL , increasingly known as in-context reinforcement learning , leaves the weights frozen and optimizes everything around them in text space.

sources.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design

claims.name: Agent–Environment Co-Evolution
claims.evidence: Agent--Environment Co-Evolution extends this loop to adaptive tasks, feedback, and interaction spaces that change with the agents.

sources.title: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't

claims.name: Trajectory-Anchored Agent Skills
claims.evidence: Skills work when noisy trajectories become procedural anchors that stabilize execution.

sources.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning

claims.name: Black-Box Plug-in Environment Reshaping
claims.evidence: To automate this process, we introduce EnvRigger, which treats the target policy as a black box, observing its execution trajectories to synthesize EnvHarness components targeting diagnosed flaws, and validating them via fresh rollouts.

sources.title: First Workshop on Meta Agents: Managing Agents that Manage Agents

claims.name: Self-Improving Agent Evolution
claims.evidence: We welcome work on agents that rewrite their own code (the Darwin Gödel Machine, self-taught optimizers), self-play and co-evolution, open-endedness, and honest analyses of how self-improving agents drift or game their own reward.

sources.title: Heterogeneous Agent Collaborative Reinforcement Learning

claims.name: Heterogeneous-Agent RL via Verified Rollout Sharing
claims.evidence: HACRL enables collaborative optimization with independent execution: heterogeneous agents share verified rollouts during training to mutually improve, while operating independently at inference time.

sources.title: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Memory for LLM-Based Agentic Systems (MemAgents)

claims.name: Online Interaction-Driven Memory Encoding, Retrieval, and Consolidation
claims.evidence: The limiting factor is increasingly not raw model capability but memory: how agents encode, retain, retrieve, and consolidate experience into useful knowledge for future decisions.

sources.title: ICML 2026 Workshop on Multimodal AI Agents

claims.name: Hierarchical Memory for Multimodal Agents
claims.evidence: Agentic systems are increasingly central to high-stakes computing platforms such as AI PCs, robotics, autonomous web interaction, and software maintenance, with their performance largely determined by how effectively they manage memory and context.

sources.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence

claims.name: Million-Token Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Persistent Rollout States
claims.evidence: At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations.

sources.title: Lifelong Agents: Learning, Aligning, Evolving

claims.name: Continual Learning for Lifelong Agents
claims.evidence: Such agents must integrate continual learning, long-term alignment with human values, and self-improvement under resource constraints to remain robust, trustworthy, and sustainable.

sources.title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild

claims.name: Continual Skill-Policy Meta-Learning for LLM Agents
claims.evidence: These mechanisms are mutually reinforcing: a refined policy generates better trajectories for skill synthesis, while richer skills provide higher-quality data for policy optimization.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents

claims.name: Interaction-Feedback Loops for Self-Improving Agents
claims.evidence: It also connects to a fast-moving frontier of self-improving agents — agent recursive self-improvement, self-evolution, agent reinforcement learning, and the loop and harness engineering that lets agentic systems keep getting better through repeated interaction, feedback, and self-refinement.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents

claims.name: Test-Time Continual Learning Agents with Memory Consolidation
claims.evidence: We define Test-Time Continual Learning Agents as AI systems that continuously acquire, consolidate, and refine knowledge and capabilities during deployment, without catastrophic forgetting or repeated large-scale retraining.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems

claims.name: Persistent Memory Layers for Long-Horizon AI Agents
claims.evidence: This shift moves AI systems beyond single-context interactions toward persistent memory layers that encode, retrieve, update, and sometimes forget past experience.

sources.title: New Frontiers in Game-Theoretic Learning - NExT-Game

claims.name: Self-Play Grounding for Strategic LLMs
claims.evidence: Furthermore, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at parsing rich context, they often exhibit brittle strategic planning and exploitable biases when interacting in multi-agent settings.

sources.title: OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking

claims.name: Next-State-Guided Online Agent Reinforcement Learning
claims.evidence: Every agent interaction generates a next-state signal, namely the user reply, tool output, terminal or GUI state change that follows each action, yet no existing agentic RL system recovers it as a live, online learning source.

sources.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

claims.name: On-Policy Hindsight Skill Distillation
claims.evidence: Extensive experiments on text-based and vision-based agentic tasks show that SEED consistently improves performance and sample efficiency, exhibiting robust generalization to unseen scenarios.

sources.title: Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning

claims.name: Gated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Agentic RL
claims.evidence: Across the Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 families on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, SDAR substantially improves over GRPO (+9.4% on ALFWorld, +7.0% on Search-QA, +10.2% on WebShop-Acc), avoids the instability of naive GRPO+OPSD, and consistently outperforms hybrid RL--OPSD baselines across model scales.

sources.title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight

claims.name: Self-Retrospection Distillation for Agent Foresight
claims.evidence: Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when 37--98% of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories.

sources.title: SKILL0: In-Context Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Skill Internalization

claims.name: Parameter Skill Internalization via Curriculum RL
claims.evidence: Yet inference-time skill augmentation is fundamentally limited: retrieval noise introduces irrelevant guidance, injected skill content imposes substantial token overhead, and the model never truly acquires the knowledge it merely follows.

sources.title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver

claims.name: Multi-User Trajectory-Based Skill Evolution
claims.evidence: SkillClaw continuously aggregates trajectories generated during use and processes them with an autonomous evolver, which identifies recurring behavioral patterns and translates them into updates to the skill set by refining existing skills or extending them with new capabilities.

sources.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills

claims.name: Feedback-Guided Text-Space Optimization for Agent Skills
claims.evidence: SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score.

sources.title: The 2nd Workshop on Lifelong Agent: Learning, Aligning, Evolving

claims.name: Memory-Managed Continual Learning Agents
claims.evidence: A lifelong agent should not only acquire new knowledge and skills, but also manage memory, personalize safely, interact with evolving tool ecosystems, and withstand long-term deployment without drift or brittle failures.

sources.title: Women in AI and Finance

claims.name: Model- and Harness-Side RL for Financial LLM Agents
claims.evidence: The workshop covers both, together with multi-agent market simulation, agentic retrieval, tool use, and sequential decision-making, and it emphasizes sample efficiency, safety, alignment, auditability, and the benchmarks needed to evaluate RL-trained financial agents under realistic, high-stakes conditions.
